content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in San Antonio

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for secondary degree holders and those without degrees to determine your qualification baseline. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your credentials before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. The instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and exam domains in real time, with Q&A support and recorded sessions for review. Schedule fits working professionals across defense, healthcare, technology, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and application steps. PMI reviews your experience and education to approve your exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers structured exam-prep resources, practice questions, and study strategies to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner at a location and time that works for you. Most candidates sit within weeks of completing their contact hours.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you hold the PMP® mark for three years. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, and community involvement. PMI's renewal cycle keeps your certification current and valued across San Antonio's major employers and industries.
